title: Constipation
summary: Encourage regular elimination with gentle support
ayurvedicView: Constipation is a classic Vata imbalance. Hydration, fiber, healthy fats, and routine help restore regularity.
remedies: Triphala powder in warm water before bed
Warm water with lemon in the morning
Include fiber-rich foods and healthy fats
Gentle abdominal massage in clockwise direction
One to two teaspoons of isabgol (psyllium husk) in a full glass of water at bedtime
tips: Drink warm water first thing in morning

icd11.title: Constipation
icd11.note: Functional constipation, diagnosed by a clinician, is DD91.1.

seeDoctor: Blood in the stool, or black stools
Constipation with vomiting, a swollen belly, or being unable to pass wind
A lasting change in bowel habit, especially after age 50 or with weight loss
